howto.what: Claude 会通过 esm Python SDK 操作蛋白质模型:用 ESM3 生成或补全蛋白序列、预测结构、由结构反推序列,用 ESMC 计算嵌入向量,并可经 Forge/Biohub 客户端调用托管模型。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 `esm` Python SDK、ESM3 或 ESMC 模型 ID、Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等来跑蛋白质任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ESM3 补全这段带掩码的蛋白序列

say.text: 用 ESMC 算这批蛋白序列的嵌入向量
say.note: 返回 embeddings 供下游任务使用

howto.what_en: Claude uses the esm Python SDK to work with protein models: ESM3 to generate or complete sequences, predict structures and design sequences from structure, ESMC for embeddings, plus Forge/Biohub clients for hosted inference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, etc.

say_en.text: Complete this masked protein sequence with ESM3
say_en.note: Loads esm3-open and generates along the sequence track

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for these protein sequences with ESMC

say_en.note: Runs ESM3 inverse folding on the sequence track
